fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Forwarding Rule
fields.help: The regional forwarding rule that fronts the mirroring collectors, for example: 'projects/123456789/regions/us-central1/forwardingRules/my-rule'.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The cloud location of the deployment, e.g.

fields.label: Mirroring Deployment Group
fields.help: The deployment group that this deployment is a part of, for example: 'projects/123456789/locations/global/mirroringDeploymentGroups/my-dg'.

fields.label: Mirroring Deployment ID
fields.help: The ID to use for the new deployment, which will become the final component of the deployment's resource name.
